sources.title: Systematic Trend-Following with Adaptive Portfolio Construction: Enhancing Risk-Adjusted Alpha in Cryptocurrency Markets
Machine learning and the cross-section of cryptocurrency returns

research_question: Does a low-turnover, broad-universe long-only time-series momentum portfolio preserve positive net OOS Sharpe when short-side exposure is avoided and risk is diversified across many liquid Binance perpetuals?
hypothesis: Crypto trends persist over multi-week horizons, while the long leg is structurally more robust than the short leg; a point-in-time liquid long-only trend portfolio should improve robustness versus fixed-major or long-short TSMOM.
economic_mechanism: Slow speculative capital rotation and underreaction create medium-horizon trend persistence; long-only exposure avoids the empirically fragile short leg and inverse-volatility weights reduce concentration in high-volatility coins.
universe_rule: At each Monday 00:00 UTC rebalance, require exact prior daily history for signal/volatility/liquidity; rank contemporaneously eligible contracts by lagged trailing-30-day quote volume and retain top 30. No forward-filled inactive assets.

signal.rule: Use prior completed-day close return over the lookback. Hold only assets with positive trailing return.

weighting: Inverse lagged 30-day realized daily volatility among positive-trend assets, normalized to 1.0 gross long exposure; cash when fewer than five assets qualify.
rebalance: Weekly Monday 00:00 UTC using only data through Sunday; trade at Monday open and hold quantities until next rebalance.

costs.funding: not modeled; any positive result remains exploratory until funding is stress-tested or reconstructed
costs.impact: not modeled; target capacity is small

development_gate: Canonical net development Sharpe >0.70, positive total return, max drawdown >-45%, and at least 2/3 lookback variants have positive total return.
success_gate: Canonical OOS net Sharpe >1.0; positive total return at 2x costs; at least 2/3 lookbacks positive; 2024 and 2025 each non-negative; max drawdown <35%; one-day execution delay positive; excluding BTC/ETH positive; removing strongest contributor positive.
anti_leakage: All rolling returns, realized volatility, and liquidity statistics are lagged to prior completed days. Universe selection is recomputed point-in-time at each rebalance.
